description: Get your home's GPS coordinates to automate your shades according to the sun's course.
security_text: Privacy & security: This page runs entirely in your browser. No data is stored or sent to any third-party server.
err_gps_unsupported: Geolocation is not supported by your browser.
err_no_results: No results. Try adding the country, or a different spelling.
err_search_failed: Search failed (this step needs an internet connection).
installer_description: Flash your ESP32 straight from this browser, over a USB cable.
installer_compat_warning: Browser installation requires a recent Web Serial-capable browser (Chrome, Edge or Firefox) on a computer, with this page loaded over HTTPS.
installer_s1_title: Do you own an official ESPSomfy-RTS box?
installer_s1_hint: The path adapts to your answer.
installer_s1_option_official: Yes, I have an official box
installer_s1_option_diy: No, I'm flashing my own ESP32
installer_s1_option_diy_desc: Generic development board (ESP32, C3, S2, S3...).
installer_s2a_hint: The model is printed on the label under the box.
installer_s3a_body: Everything is pre-configured for your box (GPIO wiring, radio setup): the interface will be automatically reachable as soon as it's powered on. You'll be able to pick the interface language in the first-boot wizard, right on the device.
installer_s2b_hint: The model is usually printed on the board or in its documentation.
installer_s3b_body: Flashing fully erases your ESP32's memory before installing ESPSomfy-RTS. At first boot, a built-in wizard will guide you through setup, including the interface language.
installer_erase_notice: ⚠️ A full flash erase is performed automatically before installation. The USB port is chosen in your browser's native picker when you click "Install".
installer_flash_state_finished_body: Unplug and replug your device, or just wait: it restarts automatically.
installer_flash_error_not_supported: This firmware doesn't support the detected chip ({chip}).
installer_flash_error_init: Couldn't connect to the device. Try again, or hold the BOOT button while clicking "Install".
installer_security_text: Privacy & security: Flashing happens entirely in your browser, talking directly to your USB device. The firmware is downloaded from the project's GitHub releases; no data is sent to any other third party.
